compact_receipt_spec.vector_hash: SHA256 of exactly 384 consecutive Buffer.writeFloatLE values, no prefix
compact_receipt_spec.source_vector_validation: Every observed native hit vector must have exactly numeric keys 0..383, finite float32 values, and byte-equal float32le bytes to the indexed source vector before stripping.
compact_receipt_spec.metadata_hash: SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON {"present":false}; no newline; insert has id+vector only and native metadata must be absent.
compact_receipt_spec.source_numeric_storage: native-bundle.json once; query and index vector matrices are lossless canonical base64 of actual C-order float32le input bytes, with shape/length/SHA256
compact_receipt_spec.retained_fields: All original nonvector fields, original Object.keys as raw_keys, exact ordered IDs and score semantics retained; only source-validated vector numeric array removed.
